absolutive expressing the act of raising or rescuing
subject referring to the practitioner meeting the prior conditions
qualifies the final state or abode
object denoting the highest state or station

items.question: What salvific attainment results for one who uplifts twenty-one generations of the family under the stated conditions?
premises: The preceding verses specify a particular conjunction of time and place.
Under those conditions, one uplifts twenty-one generations of the family.
Such uplift leads to a supreme attainment.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner who uplifts twenty-one generations of the family attains the supreme abode.
uncertainties: The exact sense of kula+ekaviṃśam (ancestors, descendants, or both) is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Having uplifted twenty-one generations of his family, he would go to the supreme abode.
